Hi there! Meridian stores timestamps in UTC and shows them in the timezone set for your account.

**To fix the display:**
1. Open **Settings → Profile** (your personal settings) and set the correct **Timezone**. This overrides the workspace default for you only.
2. If you want to change the default for the whole workspace, go to **Settings → General** and update the **Workspace default timezone** there. Any users without a personal timezone set will then see timestamps in the new default.

After updating the setting, the timestamps will refresh to the correct timezone.

Let me know if you need any more help!
